description.value: Claytons Heritage Market is a full-size supermarket that has anchored Sechelt's Trail Bay Centre Mall since 1950, making it one of the longest-running grocery stores on BC's Sunshine Coast. The store carries fresh produce, quality meats, an in-house bakery, a deli counter, and a broad selection of natural and organic foods. For cyclists touring the Sunshine Coast Highway, it offers a comprehensive resupply option in the region's main service hub.
